Yes. The latest assessment identified a **candidate tree-cover loss of 13.5 hectares in 2025**, about 3.9% of the property.

The finding is **pending corroboration**: 2025 is the latest year observed, so a later year is needed to assess whether the change persists. The evidence does not establish the cause, whether deforestation or land-use change occurred, or whether the activity was legal.

No loss event of at least 0.5 hectares was detected during 2021–2024.
